perspective: Simulated first-use busy family carer; independent assessment of parent-actuated evidence

rubric.confidence: Limited to captured browser evidence; actions were parent actuated and do not establish independent discovery or completion time.

journeys.goal: Help someone while preserving their choices
journeys.result: Help page offers support preferences, separate appointment questions, and a communication card; privacy boundary is explicit.

journeys.goal: Select, save, return to, and export support preferences
journeys.result: Selected preference and synthetic note survive in-app return and explicit save/reload; text export contains selected content.

journeys.goal: Preview and save a blank-start practical card
journeys.result: Optional fields and preview work; output contains intended fields. Saved-card edit was not exercised.

journeys.goal: Create and keep a separate milestone card
journeys.result: Optional date can be omitted; content remains separate from the practical card through preview, output, reload, and deletion.
Local-storage and export limits are stated; deletion cancellation via Escape is inconsistent for cards.

wider_coverage.menu_destinations: 9 destinations observed in shared menu coverage; parent/shared T1 evidence, not T4 navigation actions.
wider_coverage.guides: 7 full guide DOM samples with source/review metadata; T5 observed section resume.
wider_coverage.appointment: T2 recorded draft return, explicit save/reload/export, and delete.
wider_coverage.display_and_recovery: T3 recorded keyboard menu movement at 320px/200% app text, short landscape, unknown route, and navigation recovery.
wider_coverage.limitations: Shared records are not independent T4 explorations; no clinical approval implied.

confirmed_findings.title: Support preferences require scanning a long list before review
confirmed_findings.detail: Fourteen checkbox choices span three sections before note and review/export actions; consider an early review path or concise starting set.

confirmed_findings.title: Escape does not cancel card deletion confirmation
confirmed_findings.detail: Card confirmation remains open and focus stays on Cancel deletion; click cancellation is available. Support-sheet confirmation behavior differs.

confirmed_findings.title: Card outputs keep models separate and exclude hidden fields
confirmed_findings.detail: Practical and milestone text/PDF content match their own forms; hidden dates and cross-card fields are absent.

confirmed_findings.title: Privacy and person choice are plainly stated
confirmed_findings.detail: Optional details, ask-first language, local storage limits, and export-copy caveats are visible.
